SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "regions.name"
  FROM regions AS regions
  GROUP BY
    regions.name
), _cm_regions__customers__orders__amount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_regions__customers__credit_sum AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(customers.credit) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.credit_sum"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  GROUP BY
    regions.name
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base."regions.name",
    _cm_regions__customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.amount_sum" AS "regions.revenue",
    _cm_regions__customers__credit_sum."customers.credit_sum" AS "regions.total_credit"
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_regions__customers__orders__amount_sum
    ON _base."regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_regions__customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
  LEFT JOIN _cm_regions__customers__credit_sum
    ON _base."regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_regions__customers__credit_sum."customers.regions.name"
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "regions.name",
    "regions.revenue",
    "regions.total_credit",
    CASE
      WHEN "regions.revenue" IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY CASE WHEN "regions.revenue" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ORDER BY "regions.revenue" DESC
      )
    END AS "regions.revenue_rank"
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  "regions.name",
  "regions.revenue",
  "regions.revenue_rank",
  "regions.total_credit"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "regions.name",
    "regions.revenue",
    "regions.total_credit",
    "regions.revenue_rank"
  FROM step1
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "regions.revenue_rank" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message: Four regions ranked by revenue (sum of order amounts, 1 = highest), with the sum of credit limits of all customers in each region, including customers who never ordered. Orders from customers with no known region are left out. A fifth region, Arctic, has no customers and no orders, so it has no revenue to rank and is not in the table.
